title: Project hold record v1
description: Written to .loop/control/hold.json when somebody stops this project. While the file exists, start, run, resume, tick, task and scout are refused for every caller that is not a person at an interactive terminal. Reading, cancel and handover stay available. Only a person removes it, with the release operation.

held_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the hold was placed.

held_by.description: The channel the hold was placed through. Any channel may stop a project.

reason.description: Plain English: why everything was stopped.

item_id.description: The work item the hold was placed for, when there was one. A hold is on the project, not on the item: a new work item does not escape it.
